# System / dev-tool apt packages, one per line, installed in a single layer.
# ROS2 packages are listed separately (they differ between the CPU and GPU
# base stages); this file is for build-toolchain + library deps.
# Comments and blank lines are stripped by the Dockerfile's xargs install.

build-essential
cmake
git
curl
wget
gnupg2
lsb-release
ca-certificates
software-properties-common
sudo
x11-apps
python3-pip
# debugger backing VS Code's C/C++ extension (.devcontainer/)
gdb

# Ceres Solver build deps (VINS-Fusion requires Ceres 2.1.0, built from
# source -- see Dockerfile)
libeigen3-dev
libgoogle-glog-dev
libgflags-dev
libatlas-base-dev
libsuitesparse-dev
libmetis-dev

# vins_lib links libcurl directly (VINS-Fusion-ROS2-Humble/vins/CMakeLists.txt)
libcurl4-openssl-dev

# camera_models package needs Boost::filesystem/program_options/system
# (VINS-Fusion-ROS2-Humble/camera_models/CMakeLists.txt); GeographicLib is
# vendored in-tree under global_fusion/ThirdParty, no system dep needed.
libboost-filesystem-dev
libboost-program-options-dev
libboost-system-dev
